demo.tryBody: Explore with sample data. Nothing is saved.
demo.banner: Demo mode. Sample data, nothing is saved.

restoreRevision.title: Restore this version?
restoreRevision.body: It rewrites the amount and the split, and every balance follows. This is itself recorded here, so you can come back.

archiveLedger.title: Archive this ledger?
archiveLedger.body: It becomes read-only, and any member can reopen it later.

deleteLedger.title: Delete {name}?
deleteLedger.body: It disappears for everyone in it.

revokePasskey.title: Revoke this passkey?
revokePasskey.body: This device will no longer be able to sign in with it.

revokeUserPasskey.title: Revoke this passkey?
revokeUserPasskey.body: They will need a fresh invite to re-enrol.

signOut.title: Sign out of tally on this device?

signOutEverywhere.title: Sign {name} out everywhere?
signOutEverywhere.body: Every device they are signed in on will be signed out.

offline.title: You're offline.
offline.body: Amounts are hidden until tally can check them, and nothing can be saved.

ledger.name: Name

kindHint.trip: A trip ends on a date. Add a budget too and tally shows what's left to spend per day. You invite the others once it exists.
kindHint.group: Runs indefinitely: a flatshare, a regular set of people. You invite the others once it exists.
kindHint.pair: Just the two of you. Invite them, or add them as a guest if they don't want an account.

ledger.endDateRequired: Pick the date the trip ends. For something with no end date, create a group instead.
ledger.inviteHint: Single use, expires in 48 hours. Anyone with this link joins as themselves, so send it to one person over a private channel.
ledger.endDateHint: Set a date for something that ends, like a trip. Leave it empty for a ledger that just keeps running.
ledger.budgetHint: Only means anything alongside an end date: tally divides what's left by the days remaining.
ledger.invitesOnHint: On. Any member can create a single-use link that admits one new person straight into this ledger.
ledger.invitesOffHint: Off. Nobody can create a link to this ledger. That suits a ledger whose people settled long ago; turn it on for a trip, where someone new is always being added.
ledger.invitesRevival: Turning this off immediately kills every link already handed out. Turning it back on revives the ones that haven't expired yet, so a leaked link is not made safe this way - ask the owner to revoke it in the admin panel.
ledger.invitesToggleFailed: Could not change the invite setting.
ledger.invitesCreateHint: Not permanent - change it any time from the ledger's ⋯ menu.
ledger.archiveBlocked: Settle up first - archiving needs every net position at zero.
ledger.deleteBlocked: Only whoever created this ledger can delete it.
ledger.duplicateHint: Copies the current members. Categories are already shared instance-wide, so there's nothing to copy there. Starts with no expenses.

member.addExistingHint: Anyone already on this instance joins as themselves, with their own sign-in.
member.addExistingNone: Everyone with an account is already in this ledger.
member.addGuestHint: A guest splits and can pay, but never signs in - the owner looks after them.
member.leaveHint: You can only leave once your net position is zero. Settle up, or have someone forgive what's outstanding.
member.leaveConfirm: Your past expenses stay exactly where they are.
member.leaveBlocked: Your net position isn't zero yet, so you can't leave.
member.removeConfirm: Their past expenses stay exactly where they are.
member.removeBlocked: {name}'s net position isn't zero yet, so they can't be removed.
member.mergeHint: Every expense the guest paid or shared moves to whoever you pick. The guest is retired - this can't be undone from here.

expense.remainderNote: Odd paise go to the payer.
expense.refundNote: This is a refund. It moves balances back toward zero.

error.exactSum: The amounts must add up to the total.
error.percentSum: The percentages must add up to 100.
error.positiveValue: Every share must be greater than zero.
error.noParticipants: Pick at least one person to split between.

expense.historyHint: Each entry is how this expense looked before that edit. Restoring one puts it back.
expense.deleteConfirm: It stops counting towards every balance.

balances.subtitle: What you and each person owe overall, across every ledger
balances.emptyBody: Once you share an expense with someone, their overall position shows up here.
balances.guestsSkipped: Guests have no UPI VPA, so they're settled by hand and left out of this.
balances.recordAllHint: This records one settlement in each ledger listed above.
balances.recordedNone: Nothing was recorded - this balance can't be settled from here. Open the ledger it comes from.

settle.partialHint: Pay part of it if that's what happened. The rest stays owed.
settle.forgivenExplain: Writes the debt off for good. It's recorded, never silent.
settle.noVpa: {name} hasn't added a UPI VPA, so record it manually.
settle.archivedNote: This ledger is archived, so settlements can no longer be recorded.
settle.netHeading: How each net position is worked out
settle.netExplain: Net position = paid − share + settlements sent − settlements received.
settle.checkLabel: Check: all net positions add up to
settle.checkFailed: These net positions do not add up to zero. Please report this.
settle.whoExplain: A short list of payments that clears every net position: never more than one fewer than the number of people. Each person's total is unchanged.
settle.pairsExplain: These are the debts between each pair of people. The payments above replace them with fewer transfers that leave everyone with the same net position.
settle.showTrailFor: Show the expenses behind this: {from} pays {to}
settle.trailSimplified: These don't add up to the whole of this payment: it also settles balances that run through other people.

profile.vpaVisibility: Only people you share a ledger with can see this.
profile.noDevicesWarning: This account has no passkey yet. Add one now: without it, signing out or losing this session locks you out for good.
profile.addPasskeyHint: To sign in on another device, choose "use a phone or tablet" when your browser asks. That passkey syncs, a fingerprint one does not.
profile.lastCredential: Your only passkey. Add another before revoking this one, or you will be locked out.
profile.signOutHint: Ends this session on this device only. Your other sessions and passkeys are untouched.
profile.emailHint: Your sign-in address. Set once, along with a password.
profile.passwordHint: A second way in, so a lost device is not a locked account.

onboarding.title: tally
onboarding.subtitle: Split expenses with the people you actually see.
onboarding.invitedSubtitle: You've been invited to a ledger. Pick a name and you're in.
onboarding.nameRequired: Enter a name so people know who you are.
onboarding.secretRequired: Enter the bootstrap secret from your deployment.
onboarding.closedInstance: This instance is invite-only. Ask whoever runs it to send you an invite link.
onboarding.passkeyBody: No password, no email. Your device unlocks tally with the same face or fingerprint it already uses.
onboarding.noWebauthnBody: This app is running inside another app's built-in browser, which can't create passkeys. Copy the link below and open it in Safari or Chrome.
onboarding.inAppWarning: This page is open inside another app's browser, which usually can't create passkeys. Tap the … menu and choose “Open in Safari” first.
onboarding.errorCancelled: Passkey creation was cancelled or blocked. If you opened this link inside another app, open it in Safari or Chrome and try again.
onboarding.errorSignInCancelled: No passkey was used. Either it was cancelled, or this device has no tally passkey yet — enter your name below to create one.
onboarding.errorAlreadyEnrolled: This device already has a tally passkey for you. Use “Sign in with a passkey” instead.
onboarding.errorDomain: This page's address doesn't match the one tally's passkeys belong to. Ask whoever runs this instance to check it.
onboarding.errorUnsupported: This browser can't create passkeys. Open the link in Safari or Chrome.
onboarding.errorAborted: That took too long and was cancelled. Try again.
onboarding.errorAuthenticator: Your device couldn't create the passkey. Try again, or use another device.
onboarding.errorSessionLost: This device dropped the sign-up part-way through. Start again from the invite link.
onboarding.errorVerify: The passkey was created but the server wouldn't accept it. Try again.
onboarding.errorNoAccount: That passkey isn't registered here. If you're new, enter your name below instead.
onboarding.errorInviteSpent: Your account is created, but that invite link has already been used or has expired. Ask for a fresh one.
onboarding.errorServer: The server hit an error. Try again in a moment.
onboarding.vpaBody: It lets people pay you back in one tap. You can skip this and add it later.
onboarding.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
onboarding.signInFailed: That email and password don't match an account here.
onboarding.inviteNotAccepted: You're signed in, but that invite could not be used. Ask for a new one.
onboarding.contactAdmin: No account yet? tally is invite-only. Ask whoever runs this instance for an invite link.
onboarding.emailTaken: That email already has an account here. Sign in instead.
onboarding.inviteRequired: Enter the invite code whoever runs this instance gave you.
onboarding.inviteUnusable: That invite link has already been used, or it expired. Ask for a fresh one.
onboarding.signUpBody: An email and a password is all it takes. You can add a passkey later for one-tap sign-in.
onboarding.passwordAlternative: Use an email and password instead

add.tripBody: Has an end date. Optional budget and daily burn rate.
add.groupBody: Runs indefinitely: a flatshare, a regular crowd.
add.pairBody: Costs shared with a single person.

empty.ledgersBody: A ledger is any set of people sharing costs: a trip, a flatshare, or just you and one friend. Create one and add the first expense.
empty.expensesBody: Add the first expense: pick who paid and who it splits between, and tally works out the rest.
empty.insightsBody: Once there are a few months of expenses, this is where categories, trends, and who you spend the most with will live.

error.crashedBody: This screen hit an error it couldn't recover from. Reloading usually fixes it.

insights.invalidRange: End date must be on or after the start date.

insightsTab.pickBoth: Pick both a start and an end date.

recurring.title: Recurring
recurring.none: No recurring expenses on this ledger.
recurring.noneBody: Rent, subscriptions, the shared broadband bill, anything that repeats on a schedule.
recurring.endsNever: Runs until the ledger is archived
recurring.deleteConfirm: Delete this series? Occurrences already created stay.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
notifications.body: Two things only: someone settles with you, and a settle reminder. Nothing else.
notifications.iosHint: On iPhone and iPad, add tally to your Home Screen first, because web push only works from an installed app.
notifications.unsupported: This browser cannot do web push.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings.
notifications.unavailable: Push is not configured on this instance.
notifications.enableFailed: Could not turn on notifications. Try again.

admin.title: Admin
admin.onlyOwner: Only the instance owner can open this.
admin.peopleBody: Everyone with an account on this instance.
admin.recoveryHint: Single use, expires in one hour. It re-enrols this same account on a new device, so their history stays attached. Treat it as account access and hand it over directly.
admin.lastCredential: Their only passkey. Issue a recovery link and let them enrol a new device before revoking this one.
admin.revoked: Passkey revoked. They will need a fresh invite to re-enrol.
admin.rpIdFrozen: Frozen permanently. Changing it would destroy every passkey.
admin.inviteInstanceHint: Single use, expires in 48 hours. It creates an account on this instance without adding them to any ledger — add them to a ledger afterwards. Anyone with the link becomes a user, so send it to one person privately.
admin.deleteUserHint: Removes them from every ledger and signs them out everywhere. Past expenses stay, so balances already recorded do not change.
admin.deleteUserBlocked: They have a non-zero balance in at least one ledger. Settle up before deleting.
admin.deleteUserSelf: You cannot delete your own account.
admin.deleteUserOwner: The instance owner cannot be deleted.
admin.clearPasswordConfirm: They will need a passkey or a recovery link to get back in.
admin.emergencyHint: For a lost device or a leaked password. Neither deletes anything: passkeys and expense history are untouched.
admin.promoteHint: Joined via a ledger invite, so they can only use ledgers they're already in. Promoting gives them full run of the instance - there is no way back.

export.body: Plain CSV, opens in any spreadsheet. This is the escape hatch, and it does not depend on this instance staying up.

import.title: Import expenses
import.mapping: Match each name to a member

pwa.updateBody: Reload when you have finished what you are doing.
pwa.installBody: Add it to your home screen so it opens like an app and can send you reminders.
